svg.title: SPECTRA block diagram · Part 3 of 3 — data side: arbiter, decode, shared D-cache, memory, MMIO, outputs
svg.text: SPECTRA block diagram · Part 3 of 3 — data side: arbiter, decode, shared D-cache, memory, MMIO, outputs
Shared by both cores. DMEM 0x1000_0000 – 0x1001_FFFF (128 KB) · MMIO 0x2000_0000 + offset, never cached · IMEM is on the instruction side (Part 1).
MMIO register select (offset) · read mux · ready (BARRIER: when every running core arrives)
D / I hit, miss · ARB / BAR wait

g.text: 1 / 6 · Arbitration Both D-ports request; the round-robin grant gives the port to one core (the other waits, counted as ARB_WAIT)
2 / 6 · D-cache hit Index reads the tags and data of the set; a tag match picks the way and word, ready in cycle 2
3 / 6 · D-cache miss The FSM takes the PLRU victim, writes it back if dirty, refills 4 words through the latency model (L + 4)
4 / 6 · MMIO 0x2000_00xx goes to the MMIO registers; a BARRIER read is parked until every running core has arrived
5 / 6 · Counters Hits, misses, retires and waits count per core between RUN_START and RUN_STOP; LEDs and SEG7 show results
6 / 6 · Streaming The streamer snoops result stores, and on each trigger sends a CRC-checked packet over UART to the laptop

svg.text: • Order: core D-port → round-robin arbiter → address decode → D-cache (or MMIO). One access in flight; the winner keeps the grant until its ready, a whole miss included.
• Hit: ready in cycle 2. Miss: 2 + (L + 4), plus L + 4 first when the victim is dirty (write-back). DC = 0: every access is one word, 2 + (L + 1).
